sources.title: theoracleguy/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Parakeet TDT 0.6B V3 is NVIDIA's multilingual automatic speech recognition model based on a FastConformer encoder and Token-and-Duration Transducer (TDT) decoder. It supports transcription across multiple European languages and is designed for fast, accurate speech recognition.
